MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The hook-and-loop strips felt like a natural next choice because, like my magnetic hooks, they offer a removable way to secure lightweight items.",
    "The fastening supplies reflected part of my recent interest in practical hardware, though only the hook-and-loop strips gave me a reason to act now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Electrical terminals, heat-shrink tubing and solder connectors require a wiring project I do not currently have; buying nuts, bolts and magnetic hooks does not create that need.",
    "The gauges and deck screws serve specific tasks I am not doing. Small machine screws do not imply a fence project, and general repair usefulness is not enough to make me choose duct tape.",
    "The COVID test and food-service scoop did not connect with my current fastening and organizing interests."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few workshop supplies seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop task.",
    "Assortment kits looked similar to my recent purchases, but an assortment is only useful to me when its contents solve a relevant problem."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The removable holding function of my magnetic hooks mattered more than a broad connection to tools or repairs.",
    "I rarely choose something just because it might be useful someday; I need a clear connection to what I want to secure or organize now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening interests but stretched them into unrelated projects that give me little reason to act."
}
